sources.snippet: Overview Granite Speech 5.0 Turbo CTC is a lightweight (~470M parameters) conformer encoder for automatic speech recognition, trained with Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) on BPE targets. It is a fast, encoder-only member of the Granite Speech family: transcription requires a single forward pass followed by greedy CTC decoding, with no autoregressive decoder.
